hints.title: Pattern question
hints.body: Ask a question that points at the relevant pattern without naming the algorithm.

hints.title: Approach
hints.body: Describe the approach in one or two sentences.

hints.title: Algorithm outline
hints.body: Outline the steps. Do not include complete code.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body: Provide pseudocode only after explicit confirmation. Never provide full code before level 4.
